human_readability.decision: Bounded fixed profile, trust ownership, step sequence, binary offsets, tests and exclusions documented; C test assertions report source line failures.

findings: Trusted anchor cannot be replaced by ordinary flash without antirollback qualification.
A correctly signed measurement is not physical truth.
Trusted local caller can forge public C structs; owner boundary must be enforced by integration.
One-peer eligibility is not heterogeneous quorum or actuator authority.
Clock rollback across reboot only checked against persisted time; platform time source must be trusted.
Profile transition, key rotation, audit failure and production update remain open.

technical_destruction.method: Real signed fixtures, all-wire bit alterations, complete persisted-byte corruption, provider fault cuts, assertion-killed guard mutants; exact results in local-validation.json and later windows-result.json

corrected_during_development.symptom: A time below the recovery observation but above genesis persisted time was accepted by first draft.
corrected_during_development.root_cause: Only persisted commit time was checked.
corrected_during_development.correction: Establish RAM clock floor during recovery and recheck in prepare/commit/snapshot.
corrected_during_development.regression: Clock rollback after recovery is rejected.

corrected_during_development.symptom: First draft expired only strictly after deadline.
corrected_during_development.root_cause: Comparison did not match ISM-R15 deadline-equality contract.
corrected_during_development.correction: Use >= deadline as expired; canonical eligible state requires last_time < deadline.
corrected_during_development.regression: Signed ACK exactly at deadline is rejected.

mutant_rule: Compilation failure or process crash is NOT a killed security mutant; require compilation/link success then exit1 from host assertion.
